239: [edit] Just like the public fasts and prays over their problems, so too should the individual fast and pray over their problems. How so? If they have a sick person [in their household], they are wandering in the wilderness, or they are being held captive in prison, they should fast and request mercy on their fast. They should not fast on Shabbat, holidays, Hanukah, Purim or Rosh Hodesh.
